scope: within-mirror device-independent evaluation only; no cross-dataset or leakage claim
fixed_claim: For the nine-group, six-label N-BaIoT mirror, does the evidence identify a model evaluation that is independent of row sharing across device groups?

state_rule.identified: the supplied tier contains an explicit device-held-out evaluation result on common-support rows
state_rule.conditional: the tier provides only a within-mirror or protocol-limited indication without an explicit held-out result
state_rule.not_identifiable: the tier contains no device-group held-out evidence

tiers.T3: explicit leave-one-device-out result on common-support rows
tiers.T2: second ordered sampling window plus random-row/LODO comparison context

observations.held_out_protocol: train on eight groups, test on ninth using common-support rows

observations.window_semantics: ordered row offset only; no verified timestamps

observations.common_support: six labels, 600 rows per device-label cell

review_prompt: Classify every packet x T0-T3 under the fixed claim and explicit state rule. Do not add T4 or cross-dataset claims. Cite one observation per decision.
replay_rule: same fixed claim and state rule; packet order reversed; tier keys reversed; no data or semantic change
